model_annotation: The image displays three donut charts comparing the share of different economic sectors—Industry, Construction, Trade, and Other Services—in terms of the number of enterprises, the number of persons employed, and turnover in 2021, with values presented as percentages of the total economy and absolute figures in millions or billions. The “Turnover” chart presents Other Services at 31% (9.8 billion), Trade at 31% (9.9 billion), Construction at 31% (9.8 billion), and Industry at 33% (10.4 billion). All charts include percentage labels within their respective segments and absolute values in parentheses. The segments are arranged in descending order of size within each chart, with no segment visually emphasized or distinguished beyond its proportional size and color.
